prompt: How old would the founder of the publishing company of the magazine that serialized the manga series Raw Hero have been the year the magazine ended publication?
answer: Kodansha was founded by **Seiji Noma**, who was born on **December 17, 1881**. *Evening* ended publication on **February 28, 2023**, so Noma would have been **141 years old** at the time.
